topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The flowers arrived in the morning, a sudden splash of color in the quiet of my day. A bouquet of sunflowers, their golden faces turned toward the light, as if they’d found their way home. No card, no note, just these bright, reaching blossoms. I placed them in a vase, the water shimmering with a promise of warmth. They seemed familiar, like an old friend greeting me with their silence. I breathed in the scent of sun and earth, feeling the day soften around me. Perhaps, I thought, the message is in the bloom itself, a silent whisper that everything is well, that someone, somewhere, thought of me today. And it was enough.
